commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' 3 - 1 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:1.
90+8' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' PENALTY APPEAL after Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+2' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+2' What a chance that is! Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s just a yellow card for Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).

88' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), but referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
88' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is rightly shocked that the referee has chosen to send him off because it certainly seems like a very harsh decision!
87' A cross into the box from Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
83' Seydouba Cisse comes off the pitch to be replaced by Diego Garcia (Leganes).

83' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
83' Borja Jimenez has decided to make a change. Enric Franquesa (Leganes) replaces Javi Hernandez.
81' 2 - 1 It's 2:1! Giuliano Simeone feeds Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
80' What was Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
77' Wow, what an escape. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
77' Substitution. Sebastien Haller (Leganes) has come on for Miguel de la Fuente.
75' Matija Nastasic (Leganes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
75' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
73' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
72' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
71' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Leganes.
69' 1 - 1 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
69' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
68' Borja Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roberto Lopez (Leganes) replacing Dani Raba.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) comes onto the pitch for Juan Cruz.
67' Dangerous play by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid). Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
66' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
64' Diego Simeone is forced to make a change. Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jose Maria Gimenez.
64' This shall not pass! Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
62' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
59' The game is interrupted now, Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

58' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
58' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' Substitution. Angel Correa is replaced by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
57' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Koke will be replaced by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid).
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) will replace Rodrigo Riquelme.
56' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but Marko Dmitrovic punches the ball away.
55' Leganes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
54' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.

52' What a miss! Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
52' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down. Jose Luis Munuera Montero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
51' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
49' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
48' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
48' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
47' The corner is swung in but Leganes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
47' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Diego Simeone has made a change at the break. Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) has come on in place of Nahuel Molina.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A spell of possession for Leganes in an attempt to control the game.
45+1' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
43' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
42' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.
41' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

41' Dani Raba (Leganes) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jan Oblak has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
41' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows the whistle, Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul.
39' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
34' 0 - 1 Yvan Neyou (Leganes) gets on the end of a great through ball and coolly strikes the ball into the top right corner!
32' Juan Cruz (Leganes) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
30' The game is interrupted. Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
30' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
27' The referee blows his whistle as Valentin Rosier (Leganes) was too aggressive in his challenge.
26' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
25' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
24' Leganes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
24' Dani Raba (Leganes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Leganes.
23' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
21' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul after Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
21' The ball is cleared after Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
20' Atl. Madrid players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
19' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) probably handled the ball.
17' Dani Raba (Leganes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for an infringement.

16' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
15' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
14' A cross from a corner kick by Atl. Madrid is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
13' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
11' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic reacts superbly to deny him.
9' Koke (Atl. Madrid) prepares to take a corner kick.

9' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Now Atl. Madrid have a corner.
8' The possession of the ball – 75:25.
8' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
5' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
5' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
3' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

2' Dani Raba (Leganes) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
1' Koke (Atl. Madrid) brings an opponent down and Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupts the game.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Leganes will have the kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero is introduced as the referee for today's match.
